reviewKind: AI actual screenshot observation plus read-only public field cross-check
scope: Exactly the 12 captures in captures-snapshot-preaudit-01.json: Transformer L0-L2, paper/monochrome,85/180mm. Raw later additions are outside this report.
limitations: Pixel observations are authored after viewing every original screenshot with view_image; parsed public DOM/receipts support identity and camera facts, not microscopic pixel correctness.
L1/L2 fit text is small; exact glyphs, font substitution, fine edge endpoints and all route crossings are not certified.
Fitting85mm and180mm to the same viewport can yield the same on-screen page size; visible page-width UI is checked, not physical printing.
Viewport capture shows whole white page and six legend marks; it is not a standalone figure or print preview review.
UA/DPR in screen receipts bind an earlier same-IAB observation; they were not remeasured at8887. Resolved fonts and hardware remain unknown.
No browser operation, raw mutation, stamp or tests/build were performed; only these two independent review outputs were created.
No conclusion applies to snapshots appended after this locked12-record input. No independent human or publication acceptance is asserted.
